No self-bsd, self-size or group-query marker was retained in any fatal attempt. The last received progress marker is not proof of the exact instruction or syscall that blocked, nor proof that no later instruction ran.

In the immutable run source, project-imports precedes argparse/ctypes/project imports. process_census imports support, which imports networking and archive utilities. abi-binding covers load_abi file/stat/hash checks and also native reader import/CDLL/timebase initialization before the next self-bsd marker.

The observed timeout therefore does not establish a KERN_PROC_PGRP hang, a permission denial, a libproc task-ESRCH race, an archive format failure or writer mutation. Startup/import/binding/filesystem/scheduler delay remains a hypothesis.

The Rust log has 53 unclassified textual error markers, while its actual command naturally exited zero and archive inspection passed. Marker counts are not a compiler-failure verdict.
